evidence.title: End of Watch
evidence.text: End of Watch is a 2012 American action thriller film written and directed by David Ayer.

evidence.title: End of Watch
evidence.text: It stars Jake Gyllenhaal and Michael Peña as Brian Taylor and Miguel Zavala, two Los Angeles Police Department officers who work in South Los Angeles.

evidence.title: End of Watch
evidence.text: The film focuses on their day- to- day police work, their dealings with a certain group of gang members, their friendship with each other, and their personal relationships.

evidence.title: End of Watch
evidence.text: Ayer, who had written several police procedural films previously, wanted the film to focus more on the friendship between partners and honest police work rather than corruption.

evidence.title: End of Watch
evidence.text: Gyllenhaal, Peña, and other cast members underwent an intensive training program to prepare for their roles as police officers.

evidence.title: End of Watch
evidence.text: Filming took place in Los Angeles in August 2011 with a budget of$ 7 million.

evidence.title: End of Watch
evidence.text: " End of Watch" premiered on September 8, 2012 at the Toronto International Film Festival and was released in American theaters on September 21, grossing over$ 57 million at the box office.

evidence.title: End of Watch
evidence.text: The film received a number of accolades, including two Independent Spirit Award nominations.
